question: How do I generate API documentation for my JSON-RPC API using Fern?
ground_truth: To generate API documentation for JSON-RPC APIs using Fern, you need to: 1) Add your OpenRPC specification file (e.g., openrpc.yaml) to your /fern directory, and 2) Configure your generators.yml to point to your OpenRPC spec by adding it under api.specs[] with the openrpc property set to the path of your specification file.

metadata.cited_context: Fern enables you to generate professional, interactive API Reference documentation for your JSON-RPC APIs using the OpenRPC specification. OpenRPC provides a standardized, machine-readable format for describing JSON-RPC 2.0 APIs, unlocking powerful documentation and code generation workflows. ## How to add an OpenRPC endpoint 1. Add your OpenRPC specification file (e.g., `openrpc.yaml`) to your `/fern` directory. 2. Configure your `generators.yml` to point to your OpenRPC spec: ```yaml api: specs: - openrpc: ../../api-specs/openrpc/wallet.yml ```
